<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    plus = []
    for n in seg:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']==12:
            b = n['boundary']
            plus.append((min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b)))
    g = [n for n in seg if n['color']=='g']
    ring = None
    if g:
        r0 = min(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) for n in g); r1 = max(max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) for n in g)
        c0 = min(min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) for n in g); c1 = max(max(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) for n in g)
        ring = ((r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2)
    G = [n for n in seg if n['color']=='G']
    Gb = [(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])) for n in G]
    return {'plus':sorted(plus),'ring':ring,'G':Gb,
            'res':{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','game_over','reward','board_changed')}}

action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':14}])
print("after click plus(1,1):", state())
</parameter>
</function>
